prompts.dendrocystites: Use case: stylized-concept. Make an original scientific low-poly 3D model concept, one complete Dendrocystites barrandei, medium-sized Letna Formation Ordovician solutan. Three-quarter elevated view on neutral warm grey background, no labels or scale bar. Body is small flattened pear/heart-shaped plated theca, gently convex on upper face, broad near posterior, narrows forward; a distinct slight preanal lobe beside the rear appendage but not extreme hyperadult asymmetry. Smooth irregular polygonal plates of varied size, no spines or rosettes. Exactly ONE short thin unbranched segmented feeding brachiole exits the narrow front apex, gently curved; exactly ONE separate much longer segmented homoiostele exits the opposite broad rear through a sharp junction. Homoiostele has a visibly broader proximal stack of tetramerous rings and long narrow tapering distal portion, gently curving, not a swimming fish tail. Include small single suranal sugar-loaf plate near homoiostele base. Ivory/tan skeletal plating with restrained muted ochre soft seam shading, no shell rock slab, eyes, legs, extra feeding branches, starfish arms, plants, support stand or text. Fossil-informed living reconstruction, not a fossil scan. Keep each appendage distinct and visible, full subject unclipped.
prompts.trochocystites: Use case: stylized-concept. Original scientific low-poly 3D concept of one entire Trochocystites bohemicus cinctan, Cambrian, in an elevated three-quarter dorsal view against neutral warm grey. A broad flattened slightly asymmetric pear-oval theca with rigid thick marginal frame composed of large individual calcite plates, small irregular polygonal pavement filling top and underside. Modestly raised anterior frame, not a spherical shell. At the broad anterior edge a clearly delimited broad operculum plate, and separately to its anatomical right a small lateral mouth leading into shallow unequal marginal food grooves. At opposite narrower posterior pole, one short straight rigid tapering jointed homostele, a stabilizer not a swimming tail or long crinoid stalk. Subtle low ventral swelling for stability. Make the thick frame and smaller interior plates distinguishable. Restrained muted terracotta and ivory palette. No arms, eyes, legs, starfish symmetry, trilobite shell, rocks, base, labels, scale bar or reference meshes. Whole organism living reconstruction with fossil-supported visible skeletal morphology.
prompts.helicoplacus: Use case: stylized-concept. Original scientific educational low-poly 3D concept of one Helicoplacus gilberti sensu Wilbur 2006, Early Cambrian, upright pear-spindle shaped theca. Full object isolated on neutral warm grey, three-quarter view. Rounded upper body and modest short tapered basal cone, not a long support rod. Fine pleated rows of small faceted calcite plates wind as a consistent LEFT-HANDED helix around the entire body. Exactly THREE narrow recessed ambulacral pathways meet at ONE lateral mouth midway up the side: two closely spaced parallel branches wind upward, and one winds downward, stopping above the tapered base. These are bands of small paired plates lying on the surface, NOT projecting arms or giant spiral blades. Two upper paths terminate just below the rounded summit. Do not show a mouth on top. Muted sea-green/grey-green plates with pale cream ambulacral plating. Shell has opaque solid volume, no slit body, no modern snail shell, no fivefold radial crown, no eyes, tentacles, stalk, pedestal, rock, labels or scale bar. Fossil-informed living reconstruction, not a copied scientific 3D mesh.
prompts.stromatocystites: Use case: stylized-concept. Original scientific low-poly 3D concept of one Stromatocystites pentangularis, Cambrian, whole living echinoderm. Elevated near-top three-quarter view on neutral warm grey. Low gently inflated subpentagonal fully plated disc, continuous body tissue between all five sectors, no projecting starfish arms and no stalk. Exactly FIVE NARROW straight raised surface ambulacral ridges run from central oral area to five rounded disc corners, with many tiny paired flooring and cover plates giving subtle crenulated crests. Interambulacral fields remain broad with small irregular polygonal tessellated plates and very subtle suture pores. Central peristomial opening is small, with 2-1-2 ambulacral organization subtly readable rather than a giant star hole. One tiny flush periproct in an interambulacrum away from center. Underside is completely plated, nearly flat with slightly differentiated central attachment pad. No thick ring rim like Cambraster, no sand-dollar slots, no modern starfish arms, eyes, tentacles, shell rock, platform, text or scale bar. Restrained warm rust red and creamy pale raised ambulacral plates; shape and macroplating are fossil-informed, color is artistic.
